thread:
Liam (Sales): FYI handing this over — TwinPeak Finance (mid-market fintech). Closed ARR: $120k ARR, trial ends next month. Primary use: document ingestion + private deployment for PII-sensitive prompts. Key asks: SSO + SCIM, VPC peering, and ingestion connector for transaction CSVs. Renewal chatter: customer wants predictable latency and lower per-token costs. 

Maya (CS): Thanks @Liam — adding CS owners. Who's owning SSO and the VPC pre-reqs? Do they need Dedicated or Private from day 1? :thinking_face: 

Liam (Sales): They prefer Private deployment (legal requires customer-managed VPC). Wants Dedicated-like performance but on their VPC. Sales has shared the data classification and SOC report. SSO is SAML, they gave metadata but say their ACS URL will change after we configure.

Maya (CS): OK. Tentative plan: 1) Kickoff + access & contacts 2) SSO (SAML) test 3) Network prep (VPC peering & IP allowlist) 4) Ingestion dry-run (sample CSV) 5) Prod rollout. I'll set owners.

Devon (Eng): I can own the ingestion connector and run the dry-run. Need sample CSV (<=500MB sample) and schema. Also confirm whether CSV has encrypted PII columns or if we should use token-masking pipeline.

Liam (Sales): Uploading sample to the secure share now. Contact for SSO/Network is: jordan.t@twinpeak.com and infra-vendor is netbridge-inc.

Aria (Support): I'll catalog runbook steps and create a private support channel once CS/Early-ops confirm. Who's pinging Security for KMS/HSM integration?

Maya (CS): I'll loop in Security after the kickoff. For KMS: they want customer-managed keys in AWS KMS. I'll collect the Key policy template.

Devon (Eng): For ingestion: quick snippet for their CSV mapping we'll test — please pass this to them: 
```
columns: [timestamp, account_id, txn_amount, txn_desc]
date_format: ISO8601
PII_fields: [account_id, txn_desc]
```
We can run an anonymization pass if needed.

Liam (Sales): Noted. Also flagging renewal risk: they mentioned concerns around cost at scale and latency SLAs. If we can show a dedicated perf baseline and a caching plan, that should reduce risk.

Maya (CS): Action items and owners: 
- Kickoff meeting (owner: Maya) — schedule this week, invite: @Liam (Sales), Jordan (TwinPeak), Dev (Eng), Aria (Support)
- SSO / SCIM config (owner: Maya -> Security assist)
- VPC peering & IPs (owner: Liam -> Netbridge contact, Eng to provide required CIDR list)
- Ingestion dry-run with sample CSV (owner: Devon)
- KMS integration checklist (owner: Maya)
- Cost/perf baseline report (owner: Maya + Eng)

Aria (Support): I'll prepare a named escalation path and create a support-ops runbook draft. Also adding a support SLO doc tailored to their latency needs.

OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled — Kickoff meeting created: Thu 10:00 AM PT. Calendar invite sent to listed participants.

Devon (Eng): One open question: do they expect streaming token-level access to internal models or will requests go through a fixed inference endpoint? If streaming is needed we need to validate NAT timeouts for the VPC path.

Liam (Sales): They prefer streaming for real-time scoring on a subset of flows. I'll confirm the exact flows in the kickoff.

Maya (CS): Great. I'll run the kickoff, collect Jordan's SSO metadata, and post back with the confirmed owners and a short timeline. Leaving a note: renewal risk = medium until we deliver perf baseline and VPC confirmation. :white_check_mark:
